correctness.rationale: Exact Pfaffian polarization and normalized-pair enumeration count all admissible polar pencils. Every quadratic lift is counted once by a graph, yielding \(q^8\) lifts per polar plane. Explicit conjugate-coordinate Jacobians prove smooth base iff \(bd+(ad)^2+(cb)^2\ne0\), with the zero pair treated separately. The exact finite-field count then yields the claimed formulas for every even prime power; two distinct checkers reproduce q=2,4 counts and radical-line singularity tests. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace the uniform proof.

value.rationale: An all-smooth linear system of quadric surfaces is a natural finite-field arithmetic family studied by Asgarli–Ghioca. The mass formula and the exact conditional incidence with smooth genus-one base loci distinguish memberwise from base smoothness across an infinite even-characteristic family, supplying a motivated invariant rather than a small unmotivated table. No theorem about moduli isomorphism classes or general odd characteristic is implied.
